item.title: Tyla Now Has Twice as Many U.S. Afrobeats Songs No. 1s as Any Other Artist on the Chart, Thanks to ‘Is It Love’
item.description:
[Intro music plays, followed by the host's energetic voice]
Host: "What's trending on Billboard? Let's dive in! This week, Tyla is on top of the U.S. Afrobeats Songs chart with her fourth number one hit, 'Is It Love'! This fusion track surged from number 25 to the top spot, with over 2 million official streams in just one week.
Tyla's no stranger to success on this chart. She first topped it with 'Water', which dominated for 55 weeks, followed by 'Push 2 Start' and 'Chanel', which also reached number one. With four chart-toppers, Tyla now holds the record for the most number one hits on the U.S. Afrobeats Songs chart since it launched in 2022.
But that's not all - 'Is It Love' is also making waves on other charts. It debuts at number 18 on the Hot R&B Songs chart and enters the U.K.'s Official Afrobeats Chart at number 3. And if you're eagerly waiting for more music from Tyla, don't worry - her second studio album, A*Pop, is set to drop on July 24th.
Tyla's not slowing down anytime soon, with two other active singles getting airplay. 'She Did It Again' with Zara Larsson is still going strong, and her collaboration with Future, 'Game Time', is climbing the charts.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's the latest from Billboard. Tyla's on fire, and we can't wait to see what's next from this talented artist. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!" [Outro music continues to play until the end]
